items.title: Christine Jensen interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, March 4, 2024
items.q: give me Jim McNeely’s book any day or the Vanguard book. I would just love to be a part of that.

ctx.x: In a way I want to blow up that whole Brookmeyer thing and just go music is music. I know that he liked to push us through development and it’s important, but what is the purpose of the development? Do you know what I mean? I mean I’d like to see three soloists going at it for ten seconds and then move on, and I’m not sure that’s a solo section anymore. Do you know what I mean? It might just be part of the form that leads to the real solo section. So again going back to McNeely it’s about putting — making the…
